tags.description: References to org.hypercerts.vocab.tag records classifying this record. All listed tags apply simultaneously (logical AND); the array carries no ordering, weighting, negation, inheritance, or rule logic, and never will — any future expression logic must arrive as a new field and must never reinterpret this one.

langs.description: Human language(s) of this record's text fields, as BCP-47 language tags (e.g. 'es', 'pt-BR'); up to three for mixed-language text. Set by the writing app from the text the author wrote, with the author able to correct it; never from the interface language or a profile preference alone. A hint for readers, not a guarantee: consumers must not hide a record because it lacks this field.

title.description: Display title for this attachment (e.g. 'Impact Assessment Report', 'Audit Findings')

content.description: The files, documents, or external references included in this attachment record.

location.description: A strong reference to the location where this attachment's subject matter occurred. The record referenced must conform with the lexicon app.certified.location.

subjects.description: References to the subject(s) the attachment is about: an activity claim, a collection, a measurement, an evaluation, another attachment (for a comment on it), or an account profile (app.certified.actor.profile). A standalone update by its author points at the author's own profile: it is an update about the author. Optional: omit it only when the attachment is recorded before the claim it will support.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created.

capturedAt.description: Client-declared time when the attached material was captured (e.g. when a photo was taken), as distinct from createdAt. Omit if capture time is unknown, if only a local time without timezone offset or only a date is known, or if no single capture time applies. Not a coverage interval.

signatures.description: Optional cryptographic signatures attesting to this record's content.

contentType.description: The type of attachment. Values beyond the known set are permitted.

description.description: Long-form description of the attachment. An inline string for plain text or markdown, a Leaflet linear document for rich-text content, or a strong reference to an external description record.

shortDescription.description: Short summary of this attachment, suitable for previews and list views. Rich text annotations may be provided via `shortDescriptionFacets`.

shortDescriptionFacets.description: Rich text annotations for `shortDescription` (mentions, URLs, hashtags, etc).

main.description: An attachment providing commentary, context, evidence, or documentary material related to a hypercert record (e.g. an activity, project, claim, or evaluation) or related to an account profile.
